- [PREFERENCE] User finds the new running shorts super comfortable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on the new running shorts and discussed the importance of hydration during runs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided hydration tips: drink water 1-2 hours before the run, aim for 16-20 ounces (470-590 ml) 15-30 minutes before, take water breaks every 20-30 minutes, consider adding electrolyte tablets, and drink water or a sports drink within 30 minutes after the run.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended looking for a water bottle that holds at least 12-16 ounces (350-470 ml), made from BPA-free materials, with a comfortable grip, leak-proof lid, and easy-to-drink spout or valve.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested considering insulation for cold weather and hands-free options like hydration belts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed popular running water bottle brands: CamelBak, Nathan, FuelBelt, Amphipod, Hydrapak.
